query: I spent my entire walk to the grocery store replaying that viral cat video where the orange tabby keeps knocking over full mugs of iced coffee right onto its owner’s work laptop, I can’t stop cackling thinking about how the owner just stared blankly at the screen instead of yelling. I also realized halfway here I forgot to grab the lavender laundry detergent I’ve been meaning to test for weeks, and I’m low-key stressing because my neighbor said they’d drop off their foster puppy for a quick visit right after I get home so I don’t have time to linger. Oh, also I’ve been trying to track down that weird limited-edition cherry-flavored lip balm that sold out last month, I checked three drugstores already and no luck. Anyway, can you help me find options in the breads & bakery section that are grain free, non gmo, either in a variety pack or the 12 count (pack of 7) size, and cost $20 or less?
